overview: The paper proposes CHORD, a framework that harmonizes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) for LLMs via a dual-control mechanism involving a global decay coefficient (mu) and a token-wise weighting function (phi) to selectively absorb off-policy expert knowledge while maintaining on-policy exploration stability.

modules.name: Data Processing & Prompting
modules.description: Module for loading, cleaning, and formatting the mathematical reasoning and tool-use datasets, including specific prompt templating with system instructions and reasoning tags.

modules.name: Expert Data Management
modules.description: Module for handling off-policy expert trajectories, including loading responses generated by stronger models and ensuring separation between SFT and RL data splits.

modules.name: Policy Model Initialization
modules.description: Module responsible for loading the instruct-tuned language models with established policies, preparing them for on-policy generation and parameter updates.

modules.name: On-Policy Rollout Engine
modules.description: Module for sampling multiple responses per prompt from the current policy to generate trajectories for GRPO optimization.

modules.name: Reward Function Calculator
modules.description: Module implementing task-specific reward logic, including hierarchical rewards for mathematical reasoning (correctness, format, length penalties) and binary rewards for tool-use.

modules.name: GRPO Objective Implementation
modules.description: Module implementing the Group Relative Policy Optimization loss, including advantage normalization, importance sampling ratio calculation, and PPO-style clipping.

modules.name: Global Coefficient Scheduler
modules.description: Module implementing the dynamic scheduling logic for the global coefficient, typically a decay schedule transitioning the training weight from off-policy imitation to on-policy exploration.

modules.name: Token-wise Weighting Function
modules.description: Module implementing the fine-grained weighting function based on policy probability, designed to down-weight tokens at the extremes of the probability spectrum to stabilize learning.

modules.name: Weighted SFT Loss Calculator
modules.description: Module calculating the SFT loss on expert data, applying the token-wise weighting function to the negative log-likelihood of expert tokens before aggregation.

modules.name: Hybrid Loss Aggregator
modules.description: Module combining the GRPO loss and the weighted SFT loss using the dynamic global coefficient to form the final optimization objective.

modules.name: Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Main training loop module coordinating data loading, rollout generation, reward computation, hybrid loss calculation, backpropagation, and gradient updates.

modules.name: Math Reasoning Evaluation
modules.description: Module for evaluating mathematical reasoning performance, calculating accuracy metrics on standardized benchmarks and extracting final answers from specific boxed formats.

modules.name: Tool-Use Evaluation
modules.description: Module for evaluating tool-use task performance, verifying the correctness of generated function calls against ground truth APIs and calculating overall benchmark scores.

modules.name: Training Dynamics Analyzer
modules.description: Module for monitoring training stability indicators, including policy entropy, response length evolution, and the shift-readapt-overfit progression.

modules.name: Ablation & Variant Runner
modules.description: Framework module for executing ablation studies, allowing configuration of different scheduling strategies for the global coefficient and alternative token-weighting functions (e.g., importance sampling clipping, focal loss).
